title: Associate Director, Medical Writing
jobDescription:
Business Introduction. At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. Find out more. Our approach to R&D. Position Summary. You will lead medical writing activities that support clinical development and regulatory submissions. You will work closely with clinical pharmacology, non-clinical, pre-clinical research, regulatory and biostatistics external partners to plan, author and deliver complex documents. We value clear scientific judgement, practical project leadership and collaborative communication. This role offers you with meaningful impact and alignment with our mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. This role will provide you with the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following. Lead planning, authoring and quality control of early phase clinical and regulatory documents. Coordinate cross-functional and external input to ensure alignment and regulatory readiness. Serve as lead author on complex submissions and contribute to submission strategy. Mentor and coach medical writers and develop training materials for the team. Identify and implement process improvements to increase quality and efficiency. Apply digital tools and technology. Responsibilities. Author and review documents including but not limited to Clinical Pharmacology Sections for Regulatory Submissions. Lead the authoring and development of Module 2.7.1 (Summary of Biopharmaceutics) and Module 2.7.2 (Summary of Clinical Pharmacology Studies), clinical study reports, protocols and submission modules and briefing documents. Maintain document trackers and flag risks early to keep projects on schedule. Ensure documents meet regulatory requirements and internal quality standards. Operate in a matrix-team and build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external authors. Provide clear, constructive feedback and support continuous learning in the team. Basic Qualification. We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals. Minimum 10+ years of experience including in early phase medical writing. Strong project management skills and ability to deliver multiple documents on tight timelines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to scientific detail. Experience working in a global, matrixed environment and managing external vendors. Preferred Qualification. If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus. Advanced degree such as MSc, Ph D, Pharm D in pharmacology. Experience leading complex submissions, preferably authoring modules 2.7.1 and 2.7.2. Familiarity with medical writing and submission tracking tools. Experience mentoring writers and leading cross-functional teams. Record of driving process improvements or introducing automation in writing workflows. Skills. Biopharmaceutics, Clinical Pharmacology, Clinical Study Protocols, Clinical Study Reports, Coaching, Early Phase Clinical Trials, Medical Writing, Pharmacodynamics, Pharmacokinetics, Regulatory Compliance. Why GSK? Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. jobDescription: The Onyx Research Data Platform organization represents a major investment by GSK R&D and Digital & Tech, designed to deliver a step change in our ability to leverage data, knowledge, and prediction to find new medicines. We are a full-stack shop consisting of product and portfolio leadership, data engineering, infrastructure and Dev Ops, data / metadata / knowledge platforms, and AI/ML and analysis platforms, all geared toward. Building a next-generation data experience for GSK’s scientists, engineers, and decision-makers, increasing productivity, and reducing time spent on “data mechanics”. Providing best-in-class AI/ML and data analysis environments to accelerate our predictive capabilities and attract top-tier talent. Aggressively engineering our data at scale to unlock the value of our combined data assets and predictions in real-time. Director of Data Engineering is responsible for the design, delivery, support, and maintenance of industrialised automated end to end data services and pipelines. They apply standardised data models and mapping to ensure data is accessible for end users in end-to-end user tools through use of APIs. They define and embed best practices and ensure compliance with Quality Management practices and alignment to automated data governance. They also acquire and process internal and external, structure and unstructured data in line with Product requirements. As a Director of Data Engineering, you are responsible for building and leading a scrum team of world-class data engineers focused on building automated, scalable, and sustainable pipelines to account for evolving scientific needs. You deeply influence the engineering direction of the Onyx platform, ensuring we built the best-in-class capabilities across data ingestion, streaming, transformation, knowledge, metadata, vectorized data pipelines and AI/Gen AI integration. You support the head of Data Engineering in building a strong culture of accountability and ownership in you team, as well as instilling strong engineering practices (e.g., testing, code reviews, Dev Ops-forward ways of working). You work in close partnership with our Platforms teams to ensure we have the right tools and ways of working, and with our Bioinformatics teams to ensure the use of appropriate schemas, vocabularies, and ontologies. This role is for an engineer who combines hands-on expertise with strategic vision, operating oth as a senior builder, architect and technical thought leader. Key Responsibilities. Lead and mentor a team of data engineers in delivering data and knowledge products that advance GSK R&D. Architect and define the long-term data delivery and operational data engineering strategy in a complex and ambiguous data and knowledge ecosystem. Partner closely with other Data Engineering leads to drive standars for observability, scalability, performance optimization and operational excellence . Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex platform and pipeline issues and represent engineering in forums related to standards, compliance, technical strategy and cross R&D data initiatives. Collaborate with ML and Gen AI teams to optimize and build data flows for fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and champion data best practices for Gen AI workfloads. Able to design innovative strategy beyond the current enterprise way of working to create a better environment for the end users, and able to construct a coordinated, stepwise plan to bring others along with the change curve. Standard bearer for proper ways of working and engineering discipline, including the QMS framework and CI/CD best practices and proactively spearhead improvement within their engineering area. jobDescription:
Business Introduction. We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance. Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply. We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients. Job Purpose. To lead and ensure best in class customer service operations as per GSK values and policies while ensuring Safety, Quality, Regulatory and Cost compliances at the CFAs. To drive process improvement/simplification by benchmarking and automation at the CFA. Key Responsibilities. Warehousing operations. Act as SPOC (Single Point Of Contact) between Trade, Commercial team and CFA. Conduct warehouse GEMBAs to ensure EHS, Quality and Financial compliances across CFAs. Evaluate and build capability of the CFAs Staff by providing/facilitating trainings. Drive continuous improvement mindset at the CFAs. Drive operational excellence across the CFAs, by mapping best in practices in warehousing operations across industry. Liasoning with cross functional teams for operational/service/compliances related issue resolutions in timely manner. Identify process digitalization opportunities in the CFA and work with local IT/solutions team for implementation. Cost and service delivery. Continuously evolve innovative distribution strategies for the region to ensure high level of cost and service delivery. Ensure cost management of allocated cost for the region towards CFA operations and distribution. Prepare annual budget for the region and support central team for annual budgeting exercise. Collaborate with procurement to optimize fixed commission and rentals for region. Support Warehousing Operations Lead in driving change management and process improvement at the CFAs. Warehousing operations Compliance(Finance, Quality, EHS and Trade). Conduct/facilitate audits to ensure SOP adherences and ensuring 100% CAPA closures on time. Ensure implementation of GSK SOPs at the CFAs. Drive EHS and Quality culture at the CFAs by liasing with EHS and Quality team . Preparation & revision of the applicable SOPs in timely manner relevant to W&D and LSPs. Ensure Zero Critical and Major observations in internal and external audits related to Quality, EHS, GMP, Trade etc. Training Co-ordinator for W&D. Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will engage healthcare professionals across Guntur to build trusted, science-led relationships that support better patient care. You will design and deliver a local territory plan using customer insight and local needs. You will work closely with colleagues across functions to solve practical challenges and help improve patient access. We value curiosity, honesty and a practical mindset that keeps patients first. This role offers clear learning, career growth, and the chance to contribute to GSK’s mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
- Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists and other healthcare partners in your territory.
- Create and deliver a territory business plan informed by customer insight and local needs.
- Share clear, accurate, science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
- Record activity, outcomes and customer insights accurately using company systems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional colleagues to resolve customer needs and improve patient access.
- Continuously learn about clinical evidence, market trends and practical ways to improve performance. Why You? Work type: This position is on-site in Guntur and requires regular travel within the assigned territory. You will join a supportive team and receive structured coaching and regular feedback. We value inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you want to grow, learn, and make a meaningful difference to patients and healthcare partners, we want to hear from you. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals
- Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
- Minimum 1 year of customer-facing field sales or territory management experience.
- Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
- Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Telugu or other local languages used in Guntur.
- Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Power Point.
- Right to work in India. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus
- Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical or healthcare sales roles.
- Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and scientific concepts with healthcare professionals.
- Strong planning, organisation and time management skills.
- Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide activity and prioritise work.
- Fluency in Telugu and familiarity with local healthcare systems in Guntur.
- High motivation to learn, adapt and take on increasing responsibility. Ready to apply? If this role matches your skills and ambitions, we would love to hear from you. The Senior Manager, Procurement Sustainability will lead GSK's global water stewardship agenda across the supply chain and play a critical role in delivering the company's Nature Positive and Water Neutrality ambitions. This role will drive the implementation of the 2027-2029 Global Water Strategy, partnering with procurement, supplier, and sustainability stakeholders to mitigate water-related risks, enhance supplier capability, and embed sustainability into procurement decision-making. The successful candidate will combine expertise in sustainability, water stewardship, supply chain risk management, and stakeholder engagement to deliver measurable environmental impact across GSK's global supplier network. Key Responsibilities. Global Water Strategy & Supplier Engagement. Lead execution of GSK's Global Water Strategy (2027-2029) across the external supply base. Drive delivery of Water Neutrality targets, focusing on suppliers operating in high water-stress regions. Partner with Procurement Category Teams, Site Procurement Teams, and suppliers to implement water stewardship programs. Develop supplier capability-building initiatives, training programs, and performance frameworks aligned with sustainability KPIs. Collaborate with external sustainability organizations and industry partners to advance long-term water stewardship strategies. Risk Management & Governance. Own and continuously enhance the enterprise-wide Water Risk Management Program. Integrate water stewardship and sustainability controls into the Supplier Information Risk Management (SIRM) framework. Represent Procurement Sustainability in global governance forums and cross-functional leadership councils. Develop risk assessment methodologies utilizing leading water-risk tools and frameworks. Nature Positive Strategy. Contribute to delivery of GSK's Nature Positive commitments through supplier engagement and strategic partnerships. Drive collaboration with internal sustainability teams and external stakeholders to identify and execute environmental improvement opportunities. Data Analytics & Performance Monitoring. Establish robust performance monitoring and reporting processes for water-related sustainability targets. Leverage analytics, AI, and digital tools to improve environmental insights and decision-making. Support quarterly and annual sustainability reporting aligned to corporate environmental commitments and Water Neutrality goals. Required Qualifications. Education. Demonstrated experience managing complex stakeholder networks across global teams and suppliers. Technical Expertise. Water Stewardship and Water Neutrality Programs. jobDescription: Job Purpose. The Senior Director, Service Now Platform & Enterprise Tools defines and owns the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for GSK’s enterprise productivity technology ecosystem, including Service Now, Atlassian, Automation Engineering, Workflow/Case Management, and enterprise service delivery platforms. The role ensures these platforms drive operational excellence, frictionless digital experiences, and scalable enterprise services across all business units. They oversee end-to-end product lifecycle management, leading Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, and Analysts to deliver secure, resilient, and automated enterprise workflows. As the senior point of accountability for productivity platforms, the Senior Director governs platform demand, prioritization, service experience, financial stewardship, and vendor strategy. They drive enterprise-wide digital service transformation by enabling automation, standardization, and workflow orchestration across GSK. Operating at global scale, the role ensures Service Now Platform & Enterprise Tools are reliable, modern, user-centered, compliant, and capable of supporting efficient operations across HR, Supply Chain, Tech, Finance, and corporate functions. Key Responsibilities. Define and own the Service Now Platform & Enterprise Tools vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap, aligning enterprise workflow optimization, service automation, and employee experience goals with business priorities and technology standards. Apply product and platform management discipline, overseeing lifecycle management of Service Now, Atlassian, Automation platforms, and related productivity technologies. Lead prioritisation and business case development, using value frameworks based on efficiency, automation ROI, experience uplift, service quality, operational resilience, and enterprise scalability. Direct and support Product Managers and Product Owners, ensuring requirements are translated into secure, policy-compliant, re-usable, and experience-centred solutions across productivity platforms. Own the Service Now Platform & Enterprise Tools budget and financial model, ensuring cost optimisation, Fin Ops alignment, licence optimisation, platform usage efficiency, and ROI from enterprise platforms and vendors. Oversee delivery of major enterprise programmes, such as service digitisation, workflow automation, cross-functional service portal enhancements, case management redesign, ITSM/ITOM/ESM uplift, knowledge management, and employee experience transformation. Govern enterprise platform and vendor strategy for Service Now, Atlassian, automation tooling, and orchestration technologies, including build/buy/partner choices, vendor SLAs, platform guardrails, and sourcing decisions. Establish and track domain OKRs and platform KPIs, such as automation rate, request fulfilment cycle time, CSAT/NPS for digital services, workflow throughput, backlog health, service stability, and platform adoption. Drive innovation by identifying opportunities for AI-enabled automation, generative assistant capabilities, process orchestration improvements, no-code/low-code enablement, and cross-platform integration. Ensure strong governance, compliance, and security-by-design across productivity platforms, including adherence to ITSM/ITOM policies, data protection, access controls, regulatory obligations, and change approval processes. Develop domain capabilities by building skills in areas such as workflow design, automation engineering, service experience, platform configuration, observability, catalogue/service modelling, and scaled agile delivery. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify experience gaps, define integration needs, and continuously optimise the orchestration layer to support evolving people services and technologies. Drive a seamless, end-to-end user experience by designing and managing the orchestration layer that connects people, processes, and technology across the workplace ecosystem. Experience and Skills. Required. Overall 18+ years of experience with typically 12+ years in digital platforms, enterprise service management, automation engineering, or product leadership roles. Proven ability to define and execute enterprise platform strategies (Service Now, Atlassian, workflow, or automation platforms). Demonstrated leadership overseeing Product Managers, Product Owners, platform architects, and operational teams in large global environments. Experience delivering large-scale service automation, workflow digitization, ITSM/ITOM/ESM uplift, or platform modernization programmes. Track record managing vendor and sourcing strategies involving Saa S platforms, implementation partners, and managed service providers. Experience governing complex enterprise platforms with strong regulatory, security, and continuity requirements. Strong financial acumen with experience managing large platform budgets, Saa S contracts, and value-realisation frameworks. Experience building domain capabilities and maturing platform governance, standards, and operating models. Strong service-experience mindset, focusing on simplification, ease of use, and user-centred workflows.
